meaning:
συ-στατικός (Tr. συν-), -ή, -όν
(συνίστημι),
1. for putting together, constructive.
2. for bringing together, introductory, commendatory: ἐπιστολή (Arist., Diog. L., al.; and see MM, xxiv), 2Co.3:1.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
